create_CudaSynchronizeHook: create a CudaSynchronizeHook to call torch.cuda.synchronize() between FSDP layer computations to decrease memory usage
test_CudaSynchronizeHook_is_enabled: test the CudaSynchronizeHook.is_enabled method to check if CUDA synchronization is enabled for FSDP model config
build_ProfilingHook: build a ProfilingHook to trigger runtime and layerwise memory profiling during VISSL training
run_ProfilingHook_memory_tracking: run the ProfilingHook memory tracking to dump per-iteration memory usage plots and traces to disk
review_ProfilingHook_runtime_profiling: review the ProfilingHook runtime profiling to enable CPU and GPU profiling with configurable warmup and active iterations
